User-visible outcome: diagnosis history now requests and renders 10 records per page (was 20), shows the current-page indicator testid `history-page-indicator`, and prev/next paging layout/disable rules are unchanged. GET /api/diagnoses now defaults to limit=10.

Changes (8 files, all inside task.json allowedFiles; HEPHI project-regression run recorded changedFiles exactly these): backend/app/api/diagnoses.py Query(10); web/src/App.tsx HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE=10; HistoryView.tsx fallback 10 + data-testid history-page-indicator; contracts/openapi.json regenerated (only /api/diagnoses limit default 10); INTERFACES.md default 10 + testid contract; focused assertions added in backend/tests/test_diagnosis_api.py, web/src/App.test.tsx, acceptance/test_business_http.py.

Verification actually run: `uv run pytest backend/tests -q` pass (1 skip); `npm --prefix web run typecheck` pass; `npm --prefix web test -- --run` pass (7 files/60 tests, includes new 11-record pagination test); `npm --prefix web run build` pass; HEPHI `hephi_check(project-regression)` passed at head 16232e9 (runId 8f591c37-c12d-4b5e-a3ff-242064af48fb); black-box `BASE_URL=<local> pytest acceptance/test_business_http.py -q -k "default_page_size or pagination or single_matches"` 4 passed. Full acceptance suite: 1 pre-existing failure `test_recovery_scenario_unavailable_cases` (independent calc expects unavailable, API computed); reproduced identically against a base bd816e9 server, so unrelated to this change; our new default-page-size test passes.

Before/After evidence in PR body (actual app captures, same 1440x900 light theme scenario with 11 seeded history records): Before base bd816e9 = 11 items on one page, page 1/1; After head 16232e9 = 10 items, page 1/2 with current-page indicator. Rendered inline via GitHub private user-attachments (verified bodyHTML rewrites). No auto-merge enabled; human merges.

Hidden-test-shaped source assertions self-checked: list_diagnoses default Query(10, ge=1, le=100); HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE=10; HistoryView fallback 10 and history-page-indicator present; openapi default 10; INTERFACES 默认10. No automated reviewer rounds used.
